text: Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase for unused items. Customer must provide proof of purchase.
Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping is available for an additional fee and takes 1-2 business days.
Once an order has shipped, it cannot be cancelled. Customers should wait for delivery and then use the return process.
Customer support is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM EST, excluding public holidays.
